spec_architectural_decisions.decision: C2 reuses the EXISTING /api/v1/webhook/event?companyId=X endpoint (new 'type' branch) instead of a dedicated signed-events route.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Q decision 2026-06-10 superseded the dedicated-endpoint idea; the INMA subscription is ALREADY LIVE pointing at this exact URL (MSSQL CompanyWebhookEndpoints ID=1, companyId=5050). A new route would require re-subscription and break the live wiring.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: signed + unsigned channels share one URL. This is intentional and immovable (live subscription). Mitigation: strict request-body size cap (413 INV-INM-007) BEFORE JsonDocument.Parse; HMAC binds each system event to the tenant whose settings_json secret validates, so a forged ?companyId cannot target another tenant on this branch.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Phone matching is digit-only normalization (regexp_replace(phone,'\D','','g')) within data.phones[], backed by a functional expression index on leads(tenant_id, normalized).
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: INMA contract v2.0 states country code is NOT guaranteed (WhatsApp leads 905..., manual entries 0555...). Full E.164 is impossible from INMA's data; the contract's sanctioned approach is digit-match across ALL active phones in phones[].
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: no E.164 normalization. Authoritative customerId->customer-selections fetch-verify (handles country-code drift) is explicitly C3. Functional index added so this is NOT a per-tenant table scan.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Phone-miss = drop-with-audit + WARN (INV-INM-005), still 2xx; no lead auto-create, no standalone selection-state table.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Q MVP decision. The raw event is durably persisted in inma_webhook_events (replayable), so state is not lost forever — a backfill can re-apply when a lead later appears.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: best-effort lead annotation, not authoritative current-state store. Raw retained for replay; a dedicated inma_customer_selection_state table is deferred hardening.

spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Numeric timestamp-freshness/replay check is implemented but config-gated OFF by default; signature verification itself is always fail-closed.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: The exact X-Invekto-Timestamp FORMAT (unix s/ms vs ISO8601) is in a PDF we don't yet have; enabling freshness with a wrong parse would reject all events. Signature is fail-closed regardless; dedupe(UNIQUE tenant_id,event_id) blocks same-id replay.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: replay window not enforced at launch. Enabled (with confirmed format + window > 7.5h retry horizon + skew) after the first live 5050 event confirms the timestamp format. Consistent with Q's fail-closed-verify-live decision.

plan.summary: FEAT-INMA-PIPELINE-V2 C2: consume INMA's signed 'customer.selection_changed' system event on the EXISTING /api/v1/webhook/event?companyId=X handler (new shape branch BEFORE message/ack checks). HMAC-SHA256 verify (mandatory, fail-closed) -> dedupe(tenant_id,event_id,30d) + durable raw-event audit -> derive opaque leads.customer_status from after-state -> 2xx. MVP: NO flow-trigger forward (C3) and NO cxapi customer-selections fetch-verify (phone-miss = drop-with-audit + WARN).

Q interview: MVP scope, new customer_status TEXT column, secret from settings_json->'inma'->>'webhook_secret', phone-miss drop-with-audit. HMAC recipe unknown -> build fail-closed + configurable, verify against first live 5050 event.
plan.interview_notes: AskUserQuestion 4/4 (all recommended): (1) Scope=MVP ingress+store+audit, defer flow-trigger to C3. (2) Storage=new leads.customer_status TEXT (leave pipeline_status untouched). (3) HMAC secret=tenant_registry.settings_json->'inma'->>'webhook_secret' (Q pastes from INMA panel; NO MSSQL fallback). (4) Phone miss=drop-with-audit+WARN (no lead-create, no cxapi). HMAC FORMAT decision: fail-closed + verify live (key=base64-decoded 32 bytes primary, digest=base64 primary, both configurable via InmaWebhook options; wrong guess => events rejected safely, INMA retries ~7.5h until corrected). New INV-INM-* namespace for INMA inbound pipeline. Contract: arch/contracts/inma-customer-status-webhook.json v2.0 FINAL (subscription LIVE on 5050 companyId=11). Discriminator: root 'type' field present (system event), NO 'messages'[] and NO 'Status'/'InstanceMessageID'.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Migration 065 adds leads.customer_status TEXT NULL + inma_webhook_events table (UNIQUE(tenant_id,event_id), raw_body, received_at index) + GRANT ALL ON inma_webhook_events TO invekto; idempotent (IF NOT EXISTS); leads.pipeline_status untouched.

/api/v1/webhook/event handler gains a 'type'=='customer.selection_changed' branch evaluated BEFORE IsDeliveryAckShape and the inbound messages path; raw body bytes captured once and reused by all three paths (existing msg/ack behavior byte-identical).

HMAC-SHA256 verification is mandatory and fail-closed: missing/invalid signature OR missing tenant secret returns 401 and does NOT write/derive; verifier is constant-time over '{X-Invekto-Timestamp}.{rawBody}' with configurable key/digest encoding (base64 primary).

Idempotency in ONE tx: event_id (body 'id', NOT NULL) de-duplicated via INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,event_id) DO NOTHING; insert+UPDATE share one transaction (no commit between). Duplicate (0 rows) returns 2xx without re-applying customer_status. raw_body_sha256 stored; on conflict the stored hash is compared and a DIVERGENT body (same id, different hash) logs INV-INM-006 WARN rather than silently passing.

customer_status derivation is exact per contract (single->after.featureNames[0]; []->NULL; multi->featureNames alphabetical CSV; text->after.textValue, missing->NULL); applied to leads matched by digit-normalized phone within phones[] (functional-indexed, tenant_id-scoped). Matched-count logged (0/1/>1); empty/no-usable-phones guarded before UPDATE; phone-miss = WARN INV-INM-005 + audit kept (no lead-create, no cxapi). DB persist failure -> 5xx (INMA retries).

Out-of-order safety: leads.customer_status_occurred_at gates the UPDATE (SET only when customer_status_occurred_at IS NULL OR <= event.occurredAt) so a late-delivered older event cannot overwrite newer state. Read-once body refactor caps size (413 INV-INM-007) and honors ctx.RequestAborted; existing ack + inbound-message paths stay byte-identical.

verification_questions.question: Is the HMAC verification fail-closed in ALL rejection branches (missing X-Invekto-Signature header, missing/empty tenant webhook secret, malformed digest, digest mismatch) such that NO customer_status write or derivation occurs and the response is 401, with constant-time comparison preventing a timing side-channel?

Does idempotency correctly use INSERT ... ON CONFLICT(tenant_id,event_id) DO NOTHING so a retried/byte-identical event (INMA at-least-once, stable id over ~7.5h) is persisted exactly once and does NOT re-apply the customer_status UPDATE, while a genuine DB error during persist surfaces 5xx (not a silent swallow) so INMA retries?

Is the new 'type'=='customer.selection_changed' branch evaluated strictly BEFORE IsDeliveryAckShape and the inbound messages[] validation, and is the raw request body captured ONCE as bytes and reused for both HMAC and JSON parse so the existing delivery-ack and inbound-message paths remain byte-for-byte behaviorally unchanged?

Does the tenant resolve strictly from the authenticated TenantContext (?companyId / JWT) — NOT from the body companyId (which is the INMA Company ID, e.g. 11, and is only cross-checked/audited) — and is the customer_status UPDATE scoped by tenant_id so a payload cannot mutate another tenant's leads?

Is the customer_status derivation exactly per contract (single->featureNames[0]; empty featureIds->NULL; multi->alphabetical CSV of featureNames; text->after.textValue, absent->NULL) and does a phone non-match produce INV-INM-005 WARN + retained audit row (no lead auto-create, no cxapi call) while still returning 2xx?

error_handling.silent_failure_explanation: Every rejection emits a distinct INV-INM code to the JSONL audit AND the durable inma_webhook_events row is written before the customer_status UPDATE. Phone-miss is NOT silent: INV-INM-005 WARN + the raw event is retained for inspection/replay. Dedupe duplicate returns 2xx by design (idempotent), logged at INFO. DB persist failure returns 5xx (never swallowed) so INMA's at-least-once retry re-delivers.

aha_moments.user_pain: INMA fires customer.selection_changed but if our handler 400s the unknown shape, INMA marks it a PERMANENT fail and the status silently never lands.
aha_moments.suggestion: Land the 'type' branch + durable raw-event store FIRST so even a phone-miss or downstream gap keeps the event for replay; only signature/secret problems reject.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Agent flips a customer's stage in INMA and it shows up in INSE within seconds — and nothing is ever lost even when a lead isn't matched yet.

aha_moments.user_pain: Sales ops can't see which CRM stage a WhatsApp lead is in without opening INMA.
aha_moments.suggestion: Persist the INMA-authoritative customer_status onto the lead so it's queryable in INSE for future dashboards/flows.
aha_moments.aha_moment: A lead's INMA stage is visible directly in InvektoServis data — the single-source-of-truth pivot becomes real.

aha_moments.user_pain: When a webhook 'doesn't work', support has no way to see what INMA actually sent.
aha_moments.suggestion: Store raw_body + headers-derived fields (event_id, actor_type, origin_request_id) in inma_webhook_events.
aha_moments.aha_moment: Support pulls the exact raw event by event_id and sees precisely what arrived and why it matched (or didn't).

aha_moments.user_pain: A wrong HMAC format guess could silently corrupt or accept forged events.
aha_moments.suggestion: Fail-closed + constant-time verify + configurable encoding; first real 5050 event in logs confirms the format before any tenant relies on it.
aha_moments.aha_moment: We flip one config value once we see the live signature and every event validates — zero risk of accepting a forgery in the meantime.

aha_moments.user_pain: Re-deliveries (at-least-once, ~7.5h window) could double-apply status or double-process.
aha_moments.suggestion: UNIQUE(tenant_id,event_id) + ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING makes the consumer naturally idempotent.
aha_moments.aha_moment: INMA can retry as many times as it likes and the customer_status stays exactly correct — no dupes, no drift.
